title: Scammers Reportedly Used AI-Generated Images of Missing Dog Archer to Solicit Fraudulent Vet Payment from Deltona, Florida Family

behaviors.text: Scammers reportedly used AI-generated images of Archer, a missing beagle mix in Deltona, Florida, on an operating table after owner a person posted about the dog on social media.
Cosens grew suspicious after checking the supposed veterinary clinic address, sent no money, and Archer was later returned safely.
